line-bye.text: See you. Click me if you need me.

line-docsToo.text: There's a docs page on it too.

line-faq.text: Good question. Here's what I know about this one.

line-find.text: What are you building? Tell me a feature, like tree data, editing or export.

line-foundDocs.text: Here's what I found in the docs.

line-greet.text: [cheerful] Hi! Ask me what this demo does, or tell me what you're building.

line-hi.text: [cheerful] Hi! What can I help with?

line-leave.text: [cheerful] Okay, I'll get out of your way. Bye!

line-license.text: The grid is free and MIT licensed. Excel and PDF export, pivot, the spreadsheet and Studio are part of SvGrid Enterprise.

line-noSource.text: This page has no source view, sorry.

line-start.text: Two steps. Install the package, then give the grid your rows and columns. Here's a complete page.

line-thanks.text: Any time. I'll be right here.

line-unknown.text: [thoughtful] Hmm. I don't know that one yet. Try a feature name, like grouping, editing or export.

line-who.text: I'm Zazo. I build data apps. I stopped writing my own tables when I found SvGrid. Ask me about any demo.

tip-00-trading-desk.text: Click a sector, like Technology, to filter all ten thousand rows.

tip-01-quick-start.text: Click a column header to sort. Click it again to reverse the order.

tip-02-sort-filter-paginate.text: Type in a filter box under a header, then sort and page through five thousand rows.

tip-03-excel-filters.text: Press Engineering only to add a filter chip. Clear the chip to see every row again.

tip-04-selection-copy-paste.text: Drag across cells and press Control C. Paste into a spreadsheet and the rows hold.

tip-05-inline-editing.text: Double-click a name to edit it, then press Save changes.

tip-06-large-dataset.text: Pick 100k by 100, then scroll. Only the cells you can see exist.

tip-07-grouping-aggregation.text: Press the Department and Country grouping. Each group row sums its salaries.

tip-08-tree-and-master-detail.text: Click an arrow to fold a folder away, and again to open it.

tip-09-server-side.text: Type a name in Search. The request waits until you stop typing, then hits the server.

tip-10-custom-cells-and-themes.text: Switch the theme to Dark or High contrast. Avatars and sparklines follow along.

tip-100-anomaly-highlights.text: Press Extreme to show only the worst outliers. Hover one to see what tripped.

tip-101-formulas-in-xlsx.text: Press Export with formulas, open it in Excel, and change a quantity.

tip-102-tree-checkbox-cascade.text: Tick a parent and its children follow. Untick one child and the parent goes partial.

tip-103-async-validation.text: Type a barcode with a wrong check digit. The cell flags it after a short pause.

tip-105-row-reorder.text: Tick several incidents and drag one grip. The whole set moves as a block.

tip-106-detail-rows.text: Open an order to see its line items, shipping, payments and support thread.

tip-107-pinned-rows.text: Right-click any row to pin it. The page totals at the bottom follow your filters.

tip-108-pinned-rows-engine.text: Untick Bottom pinned to drop the page totals row. The top totals stay put.

tip-109-column-reorder-engine.text: Drag a column header sideways to move the whole column.

tip-11-stock-market.text: Press Pause to freeze the ticking prices. The cells stop flashing up and down.

tip-110-locale-aware-filter.text: Press munchen. It finds München even though you typed no accent.

tip-111-set-filter-advanced.text: Press Load values from server to fill a set filter with a list too big to ship.

tip-112-barcode-cells.text: Untick Human-readable digits, or click a row for a shelf-label preview.

tip-113-cursor-pagination.text: Press Next a few times. Each page comes from a cursor token, not a row offset.

tip-114-server-grouping.text: Press Benchmark on this machine to time grouping on the client against the server.

tip-115-optimistic-updates.text: Edit a price. It saves at once; if the server rejects it, the old value comes back.

tip-116-websocket-live-updates.text: Drag the throughput slider up. Updated cells flash as more changes stream in.

tip-117-bulk-operations.text: Tick some rows, set concurrency to 10 and run. Each row gets its own outcome chip.

tip-118-live-dashboard.text: Press Pause stream to freeze the live feed of ten million transactions.

tip-118-range-selection.text: Hold Control and drag a second block. Both ranges stay selected and copy together.

tip-119-workbook-multi-sheet.text: Press Open to load an xlsx or csv file of your own into the workbook.

tip-12-hr-team.text: Press Team to group the directory by team, or try Location and Status.

tip-120-test-systems-monitor.text: Press Group by site to fold the fleet into one group per site.

tip-121-pivot-conditional-cells.text: Press Sort row labels. The traffic-light pills and data bars move with their rows.

tip-122-pivot-drill-through.text: Click any value in the pivot. The right rail lists the source rows behind it.

tip-123-pivot-totals.text: Untick Row subtotals and the sigma rows vanish. The counts panel updates.

tip-124-pivot-olap.text: Press EMEA in the slicer rail to narrow the cube to one region.

tip-125-pivot-charts.text: Click a region row in the cube. Both charts drill down to its countries.

tip-126-export-grouped-grid.text: Group by Region, then press Export to xlsx. The groups come along.

tip-127-export-pivot-grid.text: Pick One sheet per region, then export. Each region gets its own tab.

tip-13-finances.text: Click the Amount header to sort the ledger by transaction size.

tip-135-shortcut-config.text: Untick sortable and the column headers stop sorting.

tip-139-migration-from-ag-grid.text: Type in the quick filter. Both grids narrow to the same rows.

tip-14-industrial.text: Press Line to group the sensors by production line.

tip-140-sparkline-cells.text: Look at the Delta column: bars above zero and below zero take different colours.

tip-141-conditional-formatting.text: Turn on Alpha heat map. Health score cells shade by value, with no custom cell code.

tip-142-group-aggregators.text: Open a region with its arrow. Its group row shows summed revenue and a median score.

tip-143-named-views.text: Sort or filter, type a name here and press Save current. One click restores it.

tip-144-status-bar.text: Drag across the quarterly numbers. The bar below shows their count, sum and average.

tip-145-transaction-api.text: Press Pause, then Step, to apply one batched transaction to the order book at a time.

tip-146-tool-panel.text: Open the Filters tab. Each column gets an operator and a value, synced with its menu.

tip-147-integrated-charts.text: Switch the chart type to Pie, then filter the grid. The slices re-aggregate live.

tip-148-server-row-model.text: Switch to Infinite scroll and drag the scrollbar. Blocks of rows load as you go.

tip-149-realtime-collaboration.text: Open this demo in a second tab and edit a cell. The change lands in both tabs.

tip-15-localization.text: Pick EUR in the currency list and every price in the grid reformats.

tip-150-scatter-bubble.text: Tick Bubble and each dot grows with the rep's deal count.

tip-151-time-series-chart.text: Pick Area stacked from the list. Dates stay spaced by real time, gaps and all.

tip-152-chart-wizard.text: Pick a chart type from the Type tab. Each thumbnail is a live mini chart.

tip-153-chart-zoom-brush.text: Drag a rectangle across the chart to zoom in. Double-click to reset.

tip-154-chart-heatmap.text: Switch to the Diverging ramp. Cell text flips black or white to stay readable.

tip-155-chart-analytics.text: Click any day on the chart and the grid filters to that day's rows.

tip-156-chart-patterns.text: Tick Pattern fallback and each region gets its own stripes, dots or hatching.

tip-157-chart-forecast-band.text: Toggle Smooth curves. The line still passes through every weekly point.

tip-158-chart-waterfall.text: Follow the bars: each one starts where the last ended. Green adds, red takes away.

tip-159-chart-streaming.text: Press Start streaming. Old ticks drop off the left as new prices arrive on the right.

tip-16-csp-compliant.text: Press Copy to grab the CSP header this grid runs under.

tip-160-chart-funnel.text: Each row in Users is one funnel step. Hover a segment for its drop-off.

tip-161-chart-radar.text: Click Aurora X1 in the legend to isolate that product's polygon.

tip-162-chart-calendar.text: Filter the Type column and the calendar heat map re-aggregates.

tip-163-chart-gauge.text: Click a row in the KPI grid and the gauge dial swings to that metric.

tip-164-chart-treemap.text: Find the biggest rectangle in the tree map: that region and category earn the most.

tip-165-chart-sankey.text: Hover a ribbon in the sankey to see how many users flowed from one step to the next.

tip-166-pivot-analysis-workspace.text: Click the Sum chip to cycle the aggregator, and the pivot recalculates.

tip-167-project-tracker.text: Press Group by phase for per-phase rows with their own aggregate cards.

tip-168-pivot-designer.text: Search for a field, then drag it into Rows or Columns to re-pivot.

tip-169-cell-borders.text: Edit a quarter so it beats its target. Its border turns into a green double line.

tip-17-accessibility.text: Turn on the high-contrast focus outline, then move through cells with the arrows.

tip-170-cell-merging.text: Change a Qty or Rate on the invoice and the totals recompute.

tip-171-persistent-state.text: Sort or resize a column, then reload the tab. The layout comes back as you left it.

tip-172-autosize-columns.text: Press Autosize every column. Each one snaps to its widest visible value.

tip-173-hyperformula.text: Edit any input cell and every formula that reads it, from SUMIF to PMT, recalculates.

tip-174-zebra-rows.text: Untick zebraRows to drop the stripes. The pinned Total row was never striped.

tip-175-value-parser.text: Type a price with a dollar sign and commas. The grid stores it as a plain number.

tip-176-programmatic-editing.text: Press Next blank and edit. The grid jumps to the next empty required field.

tip-177-full-row-editing.text: Double-click a row: every cell in it turns editable. Press Escape to cancel the row.

tip-178-multi-condition-filter.text: Press the salary band preset. One column now holds two conditions joined by AND.

tip-179-floating-filters.text: Open an operator funnel in the filter row and pick Between. A second To box appears.

tip-18-cascade-editing.text: Change a quantity and watch the line total and the summary follow.

tip-180-row-dragging.text: Drag a task by its grip into the other grid. It leaves this one and lands there.

tip-181-master-detail-grid.text: Open an account row. A full nested grid of its calls appears underneath.

tip-182-aligned-grids.text: Resize the Jan column in one grid. The same column in the other grid follows.

tip-183-collapsible-column-groups.text: Press the caret on Q2. Its three months open beside the total.

tip-184-external-drop-zone.text: Drag a task out onto the Archive or Delete bucket. The row leaves the grid.

tip-185-column-menu-tabs.text: Turn on columnMenuTabs, then open a column menu. It now has tabs.

tip-186-headless-table.text: Type in the filter box. The engine filters, and the table is plain HTML.

tip-187-headless-virtual.text: Scroll this list fast. Fifty thousand rows, and only about twenty exist at once.

tip-188-headless-styled.text: Switch the preset to card, then tick Zebra. Same table, a different look.

tip-189-headless-shared-state.text: Click a header in either table. The other one re-sorts too, from one shared state.

tip-19-ssr.text: Press Take snapshot to see the grid markup as it renders with no JavaScript.

tip-190-headless-row-models.text: Set Group by to Lang. Rows fold into groups with a sum on each.

tip-191-headless-server-side.text: Type in the search box. Each change sends one request; watch the counter.

tip-193-studio-live-sql.text: Press New customer. It runs a real SQL insert on Postgres inside your browser.

tip-194-studio-supabase.text: Press Try the hosted sample to load a live Supabase table into the grid.

tip-195-studio-relations.text: Press New contact and search the Company picker. The grid shows the name.

tip-196-studio-auth.text: Enter any email and password, then press Sign in to reach the grid.

tip-197-studio-chart.text: Click a bar in the chart and the grid filters to that tier.

tip-198-studio-form-fields.text: Press New member and pick a country. The City list changes to match.

tip-199-studio-computed-hooks.text: Press New order and type a quantity. The total recomputes as you type.

tip-20-industrial-dashboard.text: Watch the OEE column. Every line refreshes on a two-second tick.

tip-200-studio-dashboard.text: Click true in the chart to drill the grid down to active customers.

tip-201-export-formatting-and-xls.text: Tick Raw values and export. Prices and dates leave as plain numbers.

tip-202-export-pdf-grouped-and-print.text: Group by Country, then press Export PDF for bold headers and subtotals.

tip-203-ai-export-and-anomalies.text: Type an export request in plain words. The mock model filters, groups and downloads.

tip-204-import-dialog.text: Press Copy sample CSV, then Import and paste it. Bad cells get flagged.

tip-205-project-management.text: Press Collapse on the Timeline group to fold its date columns away.

tip-206-cell-validation.text: Set a salary above two hundred thousand. The cell turns red; hover it for the reason.

tip-207-blank-sheet.text: Click a cell, type a few numbers down a column, then press Alt and equals for AutoSum.

tip-208-freeze-panes.text: Scroll right across the months. The Account and Owner columns stay frozen.

tip-209-data-validation.text: Double-click a Status cell for its dropdown. Fix a red cell and the error clears.

tip-21-export-and-print.text: Press Export Excel to download the grid as an xlsx file.

tip-210-format-cells.text: Select a range and press the currency button. Only the display changes.

tip-211-financial-model.text: Change a blue input, like the APR, and all 360 rows recompute.

tip-212-dashboard-sheet.text: Edit a weekly number and watch the sparkline, the heatmap and the totals update.

tip-22-admin-template.text: Open Customers and edit a cell in place.

tip-23-bulk-actions.text: Tick a few rows. A bar appears with Mark in stock, Copy and Delete.

tip-24-validation.text: Type an age under 18 in the Age column. The edit is refused.

tip-25-column-pinning.text: Open the Company column menu and pin it left. Scroll sideways: it stays put.

tip-250-calendar.text: Switch the selection dropdown to range, then click two days to pick a span.

tip-251-timepicker.text: Click an hour on the dial. With Auto-switch on, it moves straight to minutes.

tip-252-datetimepicker.text: Open the picker, choose a day, then use the Time tab to set the clock.

tip-253-buttons-toggles.text: Hold down Increase and the value keeps climbing until you let go.

tip-254-text-inputs.text: Click the colour swatch to open the palette and pick a new shade.

tip-255-selection.text: Open the country picker and type a name to search the list with flags.

tip-256-range-feedback.text: Drag both thumbs on Price range to narrow the band from each end.

tip-257-tabs-tree-form.text: Open the Tree tab and tick a folder. Its children tick with it.

tip-258-calendar-range.text: Press Last 7 days and the range snaps to the week ending today.

tip-259-datetimepicker-forms.text: Open the constrained field: days past the next 90 cannot be picked.

tip-26-list-chips-editors.text: Double-click a Tags cell and type a tag of your own.

tip-260-calendar-birthday.text: Pick a birth year, then a day. Future dates stay blocked and the age updates.

tip-260-headless-editors.text: Pick a framework in either list. One headless core drives both of them.

tip-261-headless-combobox.text: Type in the custom filter box. Both pickers share one value.

tip-262-headless-dropdownlist.text: Open the custom Normal menu and pick a priority. The styled list follows.

tip-263-headless-autocomplete.text: Type a city in either box and pick a suggestion. The other shows the same text.

tip-264-headless-tagsinput.text: Remove the svelte chip in one editor and it vanishes from the other too.

tip-265-headless-countryinput.text: Open the custom Germany picker and pick a country. The styled one updates too.

tip-266-headless-numberinput.text: Step the custom counter up. The styled number input shows the same value.

tip-267-headless-maskedinput.text: Type a code into the boxed field and watch the badge go from partial to complete.

tip-268-headless-phoneinput.text: Pick a country in one picker and the other field switches its dial code too.

tip-269-headless-colorinput.text: Pick a swatch in the inline panel and the portalled color input follows.

tip-27-spreadsheet-ribbon.text: Press Control B on a cell and the Bold button on the Home tab lights up.

tip-270-headless-passwordinput.text: Type a passphrase and watch both strength meters climb together.

tip-271-headless-togglebutton.text: Click the Off pill to turn it on. The Bold button presses down with it.

tip-272-headless-switchbutton.text: Flip Notifications and the custom sliding knob moves to match.

tip-273-headless-checkbox.text: Click the Accept terms card and the styled checkbox ticks with it.

tip-274-headless-radiogroup.text: Pick PayPal in the radio group and the custom segmented control follows.

tip-275-headless-rating.text: Click the fourth star and the custom segmented meter lights up to match.

tip-276-headless-calendar.text: Pick a day in the styled calendar and the compact day grid highlights it too.

tip-277-headless-timepicker.text: Drag the clock hand and watch the digital readout change with it.

tip-278-headless-datetimepicker.text: Type a date and time in the masked field and the styled picker picks it up.

tip-279-headless-tabs.text: Click Activity in the tabs and the custom segmented control switches too.

tip-28-org-chart-tree.text: Press Expand all to open the whole org chart. Reports counts everyone below.

tip-280-headless-tree.text: Expand a folder with the arrow and select a file. Both trees share the selection.

tip-281-headless-slider.text: Drag the slider and the custom bar follows to the same number.

tip-282-headless-gauge.text: Drag the slider to swing the needle on both the styled and the custom gauge.

tip-283-daterange-input.text: Click the range field and pick a preset like Last 7 days.

tip-284-button-group.text: Press B and then I. The formatting group lets several stay on at once.

tip-285-accordion.text: Click How does shipping work, then use the arrow keys to move between headers.

tip-286-splitter.text: Tick Right-to-left, then drag the divider. The drag direction flips.

tip-287-file-upload.text: Drag files onto Documents, or click it to browse. Files that are too big get rejected.

tip-288-overlays.text: Tick Draggable, then press Open modal and move the dialog around. Escape closes it.

tip-289-overlays-hovercard-menubar.text: Click File in the menubar, then use the arrow keys to move between menus.

tip-29-wbs-project-tree.text: Edit a subtask completion. Its task and phase recompute their progress above it.

tip-290-input-adornments.text: Type in the search box, then press Clear to empty it again.

tip-30-bom-tree.text: Change a part unit cost. Every subtotal above it, up to the grand total, updates.

tip-300-number-input.text: Type a large figure into Monthly budget and watch the thousands get grouped.

tip-301-password-input.text: Type in New password and the strength meter fills as it gets harder to guess.

tip-302-masked-input.text: Type into Licence plate: letters fill the first two slots, digits go after the dash.

tip-303-phone-input.text: Change the country and the dial code and number mask switch with it.

tip-304-color-input.text: Click a swatch, then type a hex code or pick from the preset palette.

tip-305-button.text: Resize the window and watch Continue to checkout keep its full width.

tip-306-repeat-button.text: Hold Increase on the quantity. The count speeds up the longer you hold.

tip-307-toggle-button.text: Press Bold, then press it again. It stays down until you toggle it off.

tip-308-switch.text: Click a switch to flip its track label between on and off.

tip-309-checkbox.text: Untick Write, and All permissions turns to a dash: partly selected.

tip-31-lazy-tree-load.text: Expand a region and a Loading row shows. Collapse and reopen it: no second fetch.

tip-310-radio-group.text: Click Pro, then use the arrow keys to move through the other plans.

tip-311-rating.text: Hover the stars and click the fourth one. The label updates as you go.

tip-312-listbox.text: Click several names in Assignees, or type a letter to jump to a match.

tip-313-combobox.text: Type in From account to filter the list. Only a listed account can be picked.

tip-314-dropdownlist.text: Set Status to another value and the issue list below updates.

tip-315-autocomplete.text: Type a city name. Suggestions appear, but any text you type is accepted.

tip-316-tags-input.text: Type an email and press Enter to add it as a chip. Backspace removes the last one.

tip-317-country-input.text: Open Billing country and type a few letters to find a country.

tip-318-slider.text: Drag the price thumbs and watch the formatted readout update as you go.

tip-319-gauge.text: Look at the coloured bands on each dial. The needle shows where the value sits.

tip-32-manufacturing-ops.text: Watch the Progress column: the bars advance on a five second tick.

tip-320-tabs.text: Click Security, then use the arrow keys to move between the tabs.

tip-321-tree.text: Type in Search files to narrow the tree, then tick a folder to check its files.

tip-322-form.text: Press Create account with the fields empty to see each required error.

tip-323-form-dynamic.text: Change Preferred contact and the form swaps which fields it shows.

tip-323-list-virtualization.text: Scroll the fifty thousand item list. Only the visible rows exist in the page.

tip-324-form-wizard.text: Press Next with the step empty. It stays put until the fields are valid.

tip-324-tree-scale.text: Open Folder 1. The tree holds ten thousand nodes, and only the visible ones are drawn.

tip-325-form-array.text: Press Add line for another row. Each row validates on its own.

tip-325-tabs-advanced.text: Press left and the tab strip moves to the left side of the panel.

tip-326-menu.text: Open File actions and press the right arrow on an item to enter its submenu.

tip-327-navpane.text: Tick Collapse to rail and the sidebar shrinks to icons only.

tip-328-tree-editable.text: Set Sort to A to Z and the sibling nodes reorder by name.

tip-329-combobox-remote.text: Type in Search repositories and watch it load matches from the server.

tip-33-server-infinite.text: Press failed to filter on the server. Then scroll: rows load in chunks as you go.

tip-330-progress.text: Press Animate and the progress bars and rings move to new values.

tip-331-app-overlays.text: Pick a side, then press Open drawer to slide the panel in from that edge.

tip-332-app-navigation.text: Press Show collapsed crumbs to reveal the hidden middle of the breadcrumb trail.

tip-333-app-feedback.text: Press Show loading and the cards swap their content for shimmering skeletons.

tip-334-checkout-form.text: Type a card number starting with 4 and the card brand is detected as you type.

tip-334-input-editors.text: In Estimate, type a time in hours and minutes. It is stored as total minutes.

tip-335-booking-form.text: Choose a service, then a date and a time. The summary fills in as you go.

tip-335-tree-select.text: Open the picker, press Right to expand a branch, and Enter to pick a city.

tip-336-filter-bar.text: Click Furniture and the product list narrows to that category.

tip-336-grid-select.text: Open the Assignee picker. Each option is a table row you can search.

tip-337-account-settings-console.text: Edit a field and press Save changes. A toast tracks the save and offers Undo.

tip-338-event-calendar.text: Press Next to page ahead a month. The repeating events carry on by themselves.

tip-338-pglite-northwind.text: Open the Products tab. Every sort, filter and edit there is real SQL.

tip-339-status-display.text: Press Dismiss to close this alert. The ones below it keep their own actions.

tip-34-realtime-orders.text: Press Simulate disconnect and watch the order stream drop and reconnect.

tip-340-command-palette.text: Press Control and K to open the command palette, then type to search the commands.

tip-341-rich-text-editor.text: Select a word and press Bold, then try a heading or a bullet list.

tip-342-carousel-tour.text: Press Start tour. Each step spotlights a part of the page, and the arrow keys move on.

tip-343-invoice-builder.text: Delete a line item and confirm, then press Undo on the toast to bring it back.

tip-343-kanban-board.text: Drag a card to another lane. Then press Table: it is the same grid.

tip-344-kanban-sprint.text: Drag a card down into another person's band to reassign it.

tip-345-kanban-pipeline.text: Drag a deal to the next stage, then reload. The board comes back as you left it.

tip-345-ops-dashboard.text: Hover API Gateway for a drill-down preview of that service.

tip-346-kanban-virtualized.text: Drag the slider up to fifty thousand cards, then scroll a lane.

tip-347-kanban-support.text: Drag a ticket into the Urgent band to raise its priority.

tip-348-kanban-content.text: Drag a piece across into another channel's band, like Social, to move it there.

tip-349-kanban-subtasks.text: Expand the sub-task count on a card to tick items off. The progress bar follows.

tip-35-permissions-audit.text: Switch to Viewer and try to edit a cell. A read-only role cannot change it.

tip-350-kanban-structure.text: Set Group by to assignee and the cards re-bucket into one lane per person.

tip-351-kanban-power.text: Click the ui tag in the filter bar to show only the cards with that tag.

tip-352-kanban-epics.text: Open the children count on an epic card to see its stories inline.

tip-353-built-in-charting.text: Change Group by to Region and the chart redraws. Click a bar to filter the grid back.

tip-354-charting-multi-series.text: Tick Stacked to pile the series into one bar. Filter a column and it adds them up again.

tip-355-charting-custom-buildspec.text: Tick a few rows in the grid and the sankey redraws for just those flows.

tip-356-spreadsheet-chart.text: Type a new number into a Units cell and the chart beside it redraws.

tip-357-ai-chart-this.text: Press Chart with AI and ask for total price by country, stacked by product.

tip-358-charting-by-date.text: Press Export chart to save the signups chart as PNG, SVG or CSV.

tip-359-pivot-chart.text: Press Chart: the same pivot layout draws as a chart. Table brings it back.

tip-36-reporting-workspace.text: Click the symbol above a column to switch its aggregate, say from sum to maximum.

tip-360-pivot-mode-grid.text: Turn on Pivot Mode and the flat list becomes a pivot table.

tip-361-dock-layout.text: Drag the README tab onto the edge of another pane to split it there.

tip-362-dock-manager.text: Press Float Explorer to pop the panel out into its own floating window.

tip-363-dock-headers.text: Press left and the tabs move to the side of the panel, stacked vertically.

tip-363-scheduler-intro.text: Switch to Week, then drag an event to another slot to reschedule it.

tip-364-dock-api.text: Press pop out Editor and watch the call show up in the event log.

tip-365-dock-dashboard.text: Move a few panes, press Save layout, then Reset and Load to bring it back.

tip-366-dock-keepalive.text: Type in Scratch A, open Notes, then come back. With keepAlive on, your text is still there.

tip-367-dock-popout.text: Press Pop out on Services to open it in its own window. Close that window to dock it back.

tip-37-theming-studio.text: Press Dark, then change the density. The CSS snippet updates to match.

tip-371-scheduler-timeline.text: Switch to the week timeline to see the whole week at once.

tip-372-scheduler-selection.text: Ctrl-click Standup and Review to select both, then drag them together.

tip-38-rtl-i18n.text: Press English to flip the grid back to left to right, with prices in dollars.

tip-381-scheduler-app-calendar.text: Untick Work to hide those events from the calendar.

tip-382-scheduler-app-clinic.text: Drag a patient from the waitlist onto Dr. Jones to book an appointment.

tip-383-scheduler-app-dispatch.text: Drag a job from the unassigned queue onto Ava Miller. Overlaps are refused.

tip-384-scheduler-app-roadmap.text: Switch to the Year timeline to see every initiative across the squads.

tip-385-scheduler-app-content.text: Press Board to see the same posts as an approval pipeline.

tip-386-scheduler-rules.text: Drag Consult into the lunch band. That time is hard blocked, so it will not drop.

tip-387-scheduler-financial.text: Move a card in the Pipeline tab, and the calendar, grid and chart follow.

tip-388-scheduler-hr.text: Change a Stage in the candidates grid. The pipeline and funnel pick it up too.

tip-389-scheduler-dependencies.text: Drag an Intake booking later. The steps that follow slide forward.

tip-39-print-board-export.text: Tick Cover page, then press Print for a boardroom pack with a title page.

tip-390-scheduler-capacity.text: Drag a shift onto another person, like Ana Ruiz, to reassign it.

tip-391-scheduler-zoom.text: Press Zoom in for hourly detail. Nights stay folded to a thin gap.

tip-392-scheduler-resource-tree.text: Switch to the Table tab. The provider groups are the same grid rows.

tip-393-scheduler-eligibility.text: Drag Panel upgrade onto Bo. Bo only does plumbing, so the job snaps back.

tip-394-scheduler-heatmap.text: Watch the Billing row. Its hours turn red where calls run past its capacity.

tip-395-scheduler-booking-rules.text: Drag Colour so it touches another appointment. It snaps back and says why.

tip-396-scheduler-bookable-slots.text: Pick Cleaning and the open hour-long slots light up on each provider.

tip-397-scheduler-multi-calendar.text: Click Personal in the legend to hide those events from every view.

tip-398-scheduler-find-a-time.text: Pick sixty minutes to see when everyone is free. Click a suggestion to book it.

tip-399-alert-rules-engine.text: Open Manage alerts and add a rule on Last. When it matches, the row lights up.

tip-399-scheduler-clinic-console.text: Click an open slot in the day schedule to book it.

tip-40-forms-master-detail.text: Pick a row, change the account name in the form, then Save or Discard the edit.

tip-400-alert-styling-rules.text: Press Simulate load and the CPU and disk cells recolour by rule.

tip-401-alert-aggregate-kpi.text: Press Close deals a few times. An alert fires once revenue clears the target.

tip-402-alert-validation-guardrails.text: Type a negative Amount: it is refused. Untick No negative amounts to let it in.

tip-403-alert-console-navpane.text: Click Critical in the nav pane and the grid shows only the hosts in trouble.

tip-404-form-rich-fields.text: Open the country picker and type to narrow the list. The whole form is one schema.

tip-405-form-cascading.text: Pick a country, then a state. Change the country and the state clears itself.

tip-406-chart-context-menu.text: Select a block of cells, right-click, and pick Chart selected range.

tip-407-grid-chart-view.text: Press Chart, then type in the filter box. The chart redraws from the filtered rows.

tip-408-segmented.text: Click 7d in the range picker, or use the arrow keys to move along the track.

tip-409-layout-feedback.text: Click Advanced options to show the hidden section, and again to fold it away.

tip-41-healthcare-emr.text: Switch to Nurse, then Physician, and see which cells each role can edit.

tip-410-typography-display.text: Scroll down to Add to favourites to see the display kit inside a real button.

tip-411-resizable-dropdowns.text: Open the Timezone list and drag the grip at its bottom to resize it.

tip-42-logistics-fleet.text: Press Pause stream to freeze the board, or Simulate dropout to cut the feed.

tip-420-block-login.text: Type a password, then press Show password to reveal what you typed.

tip-421-block-signup.text: Type a password and watch the strength meter rate it as you go.

tip-422-block-otp.text: Enter six zeros as the code and press Verify to see the error path.

tip-423-block-dashboard.text: Switch the range to thirty days to see the dashboard for that period.

tip-424-block-app-shell.text: Press Toggle sidebar to collapse the navigation into an icon rail.

tip-425-block-pricing.text: Switch to Annual and every plan price drops by the discount.

tip-426-tree-data.text: Press Expand all, or open one manager at a time with the arrow.

tip-427-group-footers.text: Switch to multipleColumns to give each grouped field its own column.

tip-428-async-editor-options.text: Open a City cell twice: the second time is instant. Invalidate cache makes it fetch again.

tip-429-move-cells.text: Select a block, then drag its border to move it. Hold Control as you drop to copy.

tip-43-compliance-queue.text: Switch to L1 and approve a case to send it up the approval chain.

tip-430-selection-bar.text: Select two rows and Merge appears in the floating bar. Press Top to move the bar up.

tip-431-custom-icons.text: Press Mixed. Four icons change and the rest keep their built-in glyphs.

tip-432-chart-candlestick.text: Press Real time and a gap opens on the axis over every weekend.

tip-433-chart-boxplot.text: Compare the bars and the boxes: two regions with the same mean look nothing alike.

tip-434-chart-axes-styling.text: Untick Decimate to draw all fifty thousand readings and see what it costs.

tip-435-chart-type-gallery.text: Click any thumbnail card to open that chart full size with its variants.

tip-436-chart-sync-zoom.text: Press 3M to zoom both charts to three months. The grid shows only those rows.

tip-437-chart-financial-workbench.text: Press RSI to stack an RSI pane under the price on the same x axis.

tip-438-chart-bar.text: Tick 100 percent and each quarter's bar shows the regions as shares of the whole.

tip-439-chart-line.text: Tick Bridge the outage on Team to draw the line across the two missing months.

tip-44-field-service.text: Double-click a Priority cell to change it inline.

tip-440-chart-area.text: Toggle Gradient fills and watch each channel's area change its shading.

tip-441-chart-pie-donut.text: Set Slices to Top 5 plus Other and the small browsers fold into one slice.

tip-442-chart-scatter-bubble.text: Tick Bubble size from units and each point grows with the units it sold.

tip-443-chart-combo.text: Switch Cost from Bars to Area. Revenue stays as bars, cost turns into an area.

tip-444-chart-distribution.text: Drag the slider to change the histogram bins. All three services share the same edges.

tip-445-chart-heatmap-calendar.text: Set Colours to Custom stops to repaint the ticket heat map with your own ramp.

tip-446-chart-radar-radial.text: Untick Cedar One to take that phone off the radar chart.

tip-447-chart-hierarchy.text: Set Colour by to Sector, then click a sunburst ring to zoom into it.

tip-448-chart-flow.text: Hover a ribbon in the sankey for its value, or a node for its total.

tip-449-chart-waterfall-funnel.text: Change Funnel shape to Pyramid and the sign-up funnel redraws.

tip-45-gantt-chart.text: Look at the Schedule column: a bar per task, a today line, a glow when overdue.

tip-450-chart-gauge-bullet.text: Drag the Uptime slider and the needle sweeps to the new value.

tip-451-chart-annotations.text: Pick Trend in the toolbar and drag across the chart to draw a trend line.

tip-452-excel-shortcuts.text: Click a cell and press Control with an arrow key to jump to the edge of the data.

tip-453-formula-bar-formats.text: Type an address in the Name Box, like C4, and the selection jumps there.

tip-454-paste-find-structure.text: Press Copy A1 to D4, tick transpose, then paste at the active cell.

tip-455-workbook.text: Change a unit price on the Prices tab, then open Summary to see it carried through.

tip-456-sales-report-workbook.text: Open the Formulas tab for the whole function library.

tip-457-goal-seek.text: Open Data, then Goal Seek, and set the profit to twenty thousand by changing price.

tip-458-data-cleanup.text: On the Data tab, run Text to Columns to split column A at the semicolons.

tip-459-named-ranges-forecast.text: Pick a name in the Name Box to jump to its cell on the Assumptions sheet.

tip-46-scheduler.text: Drag the Annual check to another provider's column to reassign it.

tip-460-review-comments-protection.text: Open Review and press Next to step through the reviewer notes.

tip-461-order-intake-validation.text: Type a Qty over 500. A Stop alert refuses it and offers Retry.

tip-462-regional-scorecard-cf.text: Edit a month in any region. Its arrow, data bar, fill and rank move with it.

tip-463-merged-report-headers.text: Click inside Q1. Merge and Center lights up on the Home tab; press it to unmerge.

tip-464-ticket-log-autofilter.text: Type Closed into an open ticket's Status and the row folds out of the filter.

tip-465-autosave-document.text: Bold a row or type a task, then press Reload the page. Your changes come back.

tip-466-paste-from-excel.text: Press Copy an Excel block, click a cell and paste. Formats and formulas come along.

tip-467-server-row-model-1m.text: Press Region, then plus Country, to group a million server rows two levels deep.

tip-468-server-pivot.text: Change the layout, then press Apply. The million-row pivot comes back in one request.

tip-469-server-tree-data.text: Open the fixtures folder. Its files come from the server only when you expand it.

tip-47-trash-truck-timeline.text: Press Dispatch depot trucks and watch them roll out along their routes.

tip-470-server-transactions.text: Tick Veto adds. New orders are refused and the log marks them cancelled.

tip-471-server-selection.text: Tick the header box, then untick two rows. The panel reads all except those two.

tip-472-server-sql-planner.text: Press MySQL. The panel rewrites the same query in the MySQL dialect.

tip-473-server-grouping-rules.text: Press pinned bottom to move the grand total. The log shows what each change costs.

tip-474-gantt-intro.text: Collapse the Design phase. Its summary bar keeps the whole span.

tip-475-gantt-editing.text: Press Zoom in, then drag a bar or its edges. The log lists every write.

tip-476-gantt-critical-path.text: Open the Table tab and read the Slack column. The red chain has none.

tip-477-gantt-resources.text: Tick Fold weekends out and the whole quarter fits in the window.

tip-478-gantt-four-views.text: Press Kanban. The same rows become cards, and every view writes back to them.

tip-479-gantt-roadmap.text: Press At risk to show only the initiatives that are at risk.

tip-48-crm-sales-pipeline.text: Press Won to see only closed deals, or All for the whole pipeline.

tip-480-gantt-program.text: Press Expand all to open forty sites and six hundred and forty tasks.

tip-481-gantt-portfolio-console.text: Read the Drift column: it shows how far each task has moved from its baseline.

tip-482-server-crud.text: Turn on Slow server, then edit a cell in optimistic mode. The change shows before the reply.

tip-483-server-master-detail.text: Click the chevron on an order to open its detail panel. The line items load from the server.

tip-484-loan-model-files.text: Open the File tab and use Save As to write the whole loan model as an Excel file.

tip-485-sheet-charts-objects.text: Drag the chart by its corner to resize it, or double-click it for the Chart dialog.

tip-486-sheet-sparklines.text: Open the Insert tab and pick a Line, Column or Win Loss sparkline.

tip-487-sheet-pivot-range.text: Open the Insert tab and pick PivotTable to pivot a block of cells.

tip-488-sheet-collaboration.text: Type a number in this sheet. The other one follows, and the log shows the delta.

tip-489-sheet-hyperlinks.text: Select a cell, open Insert and choose Link, or press Control K.

tip-49-admin-dashboard.text: Press Invite user to open the invite dialog and add someone to the list.

tip-490-sheet-let-lambda.text: Open the Formulas tab to look up LET, LAMBDA and helpers like MAP and SCAN.

tip-491-sheet-tables.text: Open Insert, then Table Styles, and pick one of eighteen looks for the table.

tip-492-sheet-iterative.text: Open Formulas, then Calculation Options, and turn on iterative calculation.

tip-493-sheet-auditing.text: Open the Formulas tab and run Error Checking to walk every cell with an error.

tip-494-sheet-cell-images.text: Sort the list by price from the Data tab. Each picture moves with its row.

tip-495-market-blotter-100k.text: Press fifty thousand a second. A hundred thousand rows stay sorted by change as ticks land.

tip-496-server-grouping-model.text: Press Load more, then open a group. Its leaves arrive in batches, not all at once.

tip-497-live-rest-dummyjson.text: Click the Price header. The public API sorts the rows and sends back a fresh page.

tip-498-sheet-bound-tabs.text: Click the Region header to sort Orders. Summary still reads it with plain formulas.

tip-499-sheet-engineering-stats.text: Open the Formulas tab to find ATAN2, BITAND, DSUM and NORM.DIST used here.

tip-50-seller-panel.text: Open the Inventory tab to see stock bars against the reorder threshold.

tip-500-worker-data-source.text: Sort in the Free grid, then in Enterprise: Web Worker, and compare the two meters.

tip-501-mail-app.text: Click Unread to see only the four unread messages.

tip-502-ops-workspace.text: Press Deploy and watch the service degrade until an alert opens an incident.

tip-503-big-data.text: Press 10M for ten million rows, then sort a column. Only the rows on screen get built.

tip-504-project-tracker.text: Open the Status column menu to edit the field and its select pills.

tip-505-gallery-catalog.text: Pick Lighting to filter the cards, then press Table to see the same rows.

tip-506-gallery-team-directory.text: Press Design to show only that team, then search for a person or a city.

tip-507-gallery-listings.text: Press Sold to show only sold listings, or pick a number of bedrooms.

tip-508-gallery-field-types.text: Press Table: every field on a card turns back into the cell it came from.

tip-509-gallery-at-scale.text: Type in the search box. It narrows all five thousand cards at once.

tip-51-ai-assistant.text: Type a question in plain English and press Ask. The mock model filters the grid.

tip-510-column-pin-splitter.text: Drag the line after the pinned columns to pin more or fewer. Escape cancels the drag.

tip-511-base-content-calendar.text: Open the Campaigns tab. Each campaign lists the posts linked to it.

tip-512-base-sales-crm.text: Open Accounts. Link a deal to an account and the account lists it too.

tip-513-base-product-roadmap.text: Open the Feedback tab to see what customers asked for, linked to features.

tip-514-base-hiring-tracker.text: Drag a candidate card to the next stage of the hiring pipeline.

tip-515-base-inventory.text: Open Suppliers. Each supplier lists the items it sends you.

tip-516-base-postgres.text: Edit a task. The change runs as a real SQL update on Postgres in the page.

tip-517-base-supabase.text: Change a task in one window and watch it arrive in the other.

tip-518-base-rest-api.text: Open Companies. The API description became tables, selects and links.

tip-519-base-from-database.text: Pick a sample database, then press Make the app.

tip-52-pivot-table.text: Open Presets to load a ready layout, or drag fields between the four zones.

tip-520-base-bug-tracker.text: Look at Triage: bugs grouped by status and colored by severity.

tip-521-base-event-planning.text: Open Attendees. Every event counts who registered and the seats left.

tip-522-base-okrs.text: Read the Progress column: a formula from start to target for each key result.

tip-523-base-expenses.text: Open Budgets to see what is left of each one after the approved expenses.

tip-524-base-onboarding.text: Drag a new hire through the pipeline, or open their checklist.

tip-53-excel-import.text: Paste some CSV here and press Preview to check every row before it lands.

tip-54-columns-hierarchy.text: Click a group chevron in the side panel to fold its columns into one summary column.

tip-55-state-maintenance.text: Change the sort, then press Undo. The grid steps back through its state history.

tip-56-export-theme-matched.text: Press XLSX: the workbook uses the same colors the grid shows right now.

tip-57-export-header-footer-logo.text: Press Download branded XLSX for a file with a logo, title and page numbers.

tip-58-export-with-images.text: Press Export XLSX with images. Each thumbnail lands in Excel as a picture.

tip-59-export-multi-sheet.text: Filter to EMEA, then press Export. The workbook still holds all five tabs.

tip-60-pivot-expandable.text: Press Expand all to see each sales person under their region.

tip-62-conditional-styling.text: Scan the Priority column for coloured pills. Breached SLA rows carry a side accent.

tip-63-column-layout-api.text: Press Finance to load its widths and pins. Save view stores your own layout.

tip-64-filter-between-operator.text: Press the first preset to keep only prices between 100 and 300 dollars.

tip-65-keyboard-shortcuts.text: Press Control K for the command palette, or Control slash for the cheat sheet.

tip-66-custom-cell-editors.text: Click a star in the CSAT column to give that feature a new rating.

tip-67-context-menu.text: Right-click a row for copy, duplicate, move up or down, and delete.

tip-68-dependent-dropdowns.text: Change USA to another country. The state and city reset to match it.

tip-69-highlighted-search.text: Type a name in the search box. Matching rows stay, with the hit highlighted.

tip-70-multi-grid-sync.text: Edit a Qty on the left. The right grid updates but keeps its own sort and filter.

tip-71-submit-validation.text: Press Submit all leads. Every invalid cell lights up and the errors are listed.

tip-72-graphql-adapter.text: Sort by Price and look at the side panel. It shows the GraphQL query the grid sent.

tip-73-chartjs-sync.text: Filter the Symbol column and the bar chart trims to the rows that are left.

tip-74-theme-integrations.text: Pick Material UI and the grid restyles. The side panel shows the CSS to paste.

tip-75-ai-smart-paste.text: Pick the vCard sample, then press Parse with AI to turn it into typed rows.

tip-77-smart-chart.text: Switch the chart to Pie, then filter the grid. The chart re-aggregates.

tip-78-million-rows.text: Group by Department, then Country. A million rows regroup in place.

tip-79-loading-from-rest.text: Press Reload. A loading skeleton shows while the rows come back from the API.

tip-80-cell-types-showcase.text: Double-click a Renewal date to edit it with the date picker.

tip-81-mobile-card-view.text: Press Cards, then tap a card to open its edit panel.

tip-82-conditional-form-schema.text: Switch a row to nonprofit in the Type column. The EIN cell opens and SSN locks.

tip-83-spreadsheet-formulas.text: Press Insert Function to browse about fifty functions, from VLOOKUP to TEXTJOIN.

tip-84-editor-types.text: Double-click a Severity cell to edit it with a range slider.

tip-85-tooltips-and-notes.text: Select a cell and press Note on selected cell. A corner marker shows it has a note.

tip-86-undo-redo.text: Edit a few cells, then press Undo, or Control Z, to step back one change at a time.

tip-87-find-in-grid.text: Open find, or press Control F in the grid, then type a word to jump between hits.

tip-88-staged-editing.text: Edit a few cells. The Commit button counts them, then sends the batch at once.

tip-89-group-panel.text: Drag the Country header into the group panel to add another grouping level.

tip-90-selection-api.text: Press Top 5 Metrics. The panel shows the sum, average, min and max of that block.

tip-91-cell-comments.text: Right-click a cell to start a comment thread, then type @ to mention someone.

tip-92-nl-filter-bar.text: Press top 5 by salary and the grid sorts and trims to five rows.

tip-93-password-protected-export.text: Type a passphrase, export, then decrypt the file below to check the round trip.

tip-94-conditional-formatting.text: Press Plain numbers to see the same data without the rules.

tip-95-fill-handle.text: Press Try this case, then drag the fill handle to see which series the grid picks.

tip-96-high-contrast-theme.text: Press High contrast to switch this grid to the high-contrast skin.

tip-97-side-drawer-edit.text: Click any application row to open the drawer. Press Escape to close it.

tip-98-advanced-filter-builder.text: Press At-risk EMEA accounts to load three rules at once, then edit any of them.

tip-99-top-n-filter.text: Press 10 for the top ten by revenue, then press Bottom to see the weakest ten.

title-1h5c82c.text: Feedback and display: badge, avatar, skeleton, card.

title-1jbzkwv.text: Engineering, statistics, and the locale you type in.

title-1k4j4nt.text: Charts and pictures on the sheet.

title-1m8gyyn.text: Two people on one sheet: the delta stream.

title-1nvqpbq.text: Format as Table and structured references.

title-1uiiv4b.text: Input editors: text, textarea, OTP, duration, multi-select.

title-1xtpgq9.text: Command palette (⌘K) and sparklines, avatars, scroll.
